about: The class of every GK.* function of the bridge, by its path under GK. fair: a player could do it through the game itself, paying what the game charges and rolling what it rolls. cheat: it sets the world, bends a rule, runs code, or is not shown to do neither. observation: it reads, and changes nothing a player could notice. The namespace decides what a verb may be: GK.Act and GK.Gui hold fair verbs and readings only, a cheat lives in GK.Cheat or a staging namespace, and an action with both forms carries the same name in each. The mod reads this file at start (Shared/Verbs.lua) and refuses, inside a step, a verb the step's class does not allow; the host reads it for bg3_api and a unit test holds it to the functions the mod's Lua defines, both ways. docs/contracts/lua-api.md, "The class of a verb".
